subject: Q3 QBR Prep — Summer Watchlist & Exec Escalation Candidates
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 QBR Prep — Summer Watchlist & Exec Escalation Candidates

Team —

Attached is the QBR "watchlist" extract I pulled for our July QBR prep. I filtered for accounts with any of the following in the last 30 days: >2 stability incidents, >20% token spend variance qoq, outstanding SSO/security asks, or renewal in the next 90 days. Quick ask: please reply with one-line updates (status / next step / whether you recommend exec attention) by 11:00am PT so I can consolidate into the leadership packet.

High-level items (sheet tab names):
- Red lane: BrightWave — renewal M-2, open SSO and data residency asks, support latency spikes.
- Amber lane: NimbusCloud — usage drop in last 2 weeks, PO delayed.
- Monitor: Orion Data — billing mismatch reported to Finance; technical lead investigating.

Attachments: [Attachment: qbr_watchlist_2027-06-30.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Proposed next steps once we have updates:
1) Confirm which accounts need VP/Exec escalation.
2) For any escalation candidate, draft an ask + recommended credit/operational remediation.
3) Lock QBR dates with external contacts (if applicable).

Thanks — can you also flag any items you think should be surfaced in the pre-read?

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
(Attachment: qbr_watchlist_2027-06-30.xlsx)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR Prep — Summer Watchlist & Exec Escalation Candidates

Thanks Neha — quick notes by account below.

BrightWave (red) — Status: High risk.
- Details: Customer reported repeated tail latency on chat gen routes after weekend deploy (infra autoscaling misconfig). They have an open SRE incident and are asking for a dedicated throughput cap while we address kernel regressions.
- Renewal: 60 days out; procurement has expressed concern about unit cost volatility.
- Ask: Recommend exec attention. Sales to discuss a 3-month bridging credit + committed dedicated pool while we stabilize (Jordan).

NimbusCloud (amber) — Status: Medium risk.
- Details: Usage down 27% month-over-month; product team cited feature deprecation and changed ingestion. Renew is likely but at risk for smaller seat count.
- Ask: Standard renewal playbook, offer a product re-engagement workshop and 30-day usage incentives. No exec escalation recommended yet.

Orion Data (monitor) — Status: Low/monitor.
- Details: Finance reported a $4k invoice mismatch (duplicate line item). Tech lead investigating; we expect resolution by EOD. No immediate exec attention.

Attachments referenced: SSR request from BrightWave (ssr_brightwave_sso_request.pdf).

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Sr. Manager, Renewal Ops
grace_oconnor@redwood.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR Prep — Summer Watchlist & Exec Escalation Candidates

Agree with Grace — BrightWave needs to be elevated. Few additional datapoints:
- Sales status: They've requested a formal SSO/SCIM roadmap and a written KCS (key control summary) for data residency. Legal is pushing back on our standard Addendum because of EU-sourced PII involved in a subset of their workloads.
- Commercial ask: Customer has verbally asked for a one-time credit to offset the operational instability. They quoted a competing vendor's aggressive trial pricing (not committed).

Proposed immediate asks for exec packet:
- Approve one-time bridging credit of up to 10% capped at $18k to buy time for the technical remediation.
- Approve a targeted engagement: VP Sales + Lead Engineer on a joint call with BrightWave CTO.

If we don't approve, I expect the customer will escalate to procurement and push for a pilot with the other vendor. Recommend VP escalation.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 QBR Prep — Summer Watchlist & Exec Escalation Candidates

Thanks all — consolidation below for leadership pre-read. Please confirm by 12:30pm PT if you agree with the proposed escalation language (I will submit the packet by 1pm).

Consolidated asks for leadership packet (BrightWave):
1) Approve one-time bridging credit: up to 10% (cap $18k). Rationale: immediate retention risk; short-term credit reduces churn risk while engineering stabilizes.
2) Approve Exec Call: VP Sales + Lead Engineer + BrightWave CTO within 72 hours to commit timeline.
3) Operational mitigation: temporarily provision a small dedicated pool (2x baseline) for 30 days pending kernel fix; cost to be run-through Finance as bridge expense.

NimbusCloud (no exec): propose re-engagement webinar + 30-day usage credits (standard).
Orion Data (monitor): Finance to confirm billing fix; no exec action.

Action owners: Jordan (BrightWave commercial ask / schedule exec call), Grace (operations remediation timeline), Vivek (confirm cost and feasibility for 2x dedicated pool), Marissa (legal - confirm Addendum changes cadence).

I'll draft the two-slide exec summary and send to this thread once approved.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Customer Success
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Neha / Jordan — thanks for the summary and for flagging the options. We appreciate the proactive outreach. Two quick notes from our side: 1) We do want an exec-level call this week — Thursday morning PT works for our CTO; 2) the temporary dedicated pool sounds like a reasonable approach as a stop-gap while you investigate the kernel regression. We will need written confirmation on the timeline and the credit terms ahead of the call.

I'll accept a calendar invite for Thu 09:30am PT and share internal attendees.
